ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

HeroTitle.helper: If left empty, it won't display.

HeroIntro.helper: If left empty, it won't display.

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Source.helper: Enter the source to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Type.helper: Choose the type from the available options.

Date.helper: Choose the date or time to use for date.

Thumbnail.helper: Choose the image or file to use for thumbnail. Use a clear file that fits this content.

ThumbnailAlt.helper: Enter the thumbnail alt to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Description.helper: Enter the formatted content for description. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

UpendoLink.helper: Enter the web address for upendo link. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Label.helper: Enter the text visitors should see for this link.

Url.helper: Enter the web address for web addresses. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Links.helper: Add and arrange the items used for links. Remove any item you do not need.

Featured.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control featured.

PressItems.helper: Add and arrange the items used for press items. Remove any item you do not need.
